summary: Strong gateway candidate; provider queues, plugin boundaries, and session affinity are distinct from agent orchestration.
Broad adapter/router reference; retain provider-specific capabilities and explicit cost, retry, and fallback policies.
Useful protocol-translation reference, but default Codex backend routing is not evidence of an officially supported integration.
Useful output compression with recovery; not a model proxy and not a substitute for complete tool evidence.
Self-hosted sandbox control plane candidate with runtime-specific container and network handling.
Good hosted execution adapter reference; SDK behavior must not be confused with proof of backend isolation.
Fast controlled shell-like operations; trusted host hooks and Node runtime remain outside the protection boundary.
Cross-platform local policy reference, including a Windows helper; verify setup and fail-closed enforcement per host.
Portable component-data protocol; explicit strict validation is necessary because absent config permits unknown elements.
Useful component catalog and validation pattern for generated app surfaces; not arbitrary executable UI.
Strong product reference for shipped versus local agent definitions and provider-specific media readiness.
Render authored HTML/media timelines as queued artifacts; isolate the renderer and preserve exact composition inputs.
Useful storyboard and character asset pipeline; checkpoint reuse needs content-aware invalidation and cost controls.
Agent-facing speech, transcription, and voice profile tools; file output avoids flooding model context.
This checkout is YuE2; symbolic plan and hashed artifacts are useful reproducibility patterns, quality claims unverified.
Research candidate for storage/RAM/VRAM MoE placement and finite-choice scoring; profile on actual hardware.
Concrete GPU memory partitioning policy and local serving reference; semantic caching is distinct from durable memory.
Study experimental provenance and reversible strategy contracts; refusal-removal is not a harness or skill optimization target.
Device task queue, trace, watchdog, and locking patterns; distinguish controlling a phone from delivering a mobile client.
Use language-aware query findings as evidence, with extraction and coverage limits; not a universal security verdict.
Dependency vulnerability evidence with explicit language/source gates for call analysis.
Useful common scanner surface for containers, filesystems, repositories, and SBOMs, with explicit artifact provenance.
Strong reference for bounded static/semantic checks and explicit incomplete-inspection ledgers.
Adopt phase/coverage ledger semantics; configuration grades and pending adjudication are not proven runtime security.
